source_atom.operation: A compressed state/projection is admissible for downstream search only if equal projected states are congruent for the downstream outcome; one same-projection/different-outcome pair is a DifferenceWitness.

target_atom.question: Can weak-L^(3/2) amplitude information (even inside smooth compactly supported divergence-free vorticity fields) determine the one-center lambda^(-1/2) superlevel morphology required by the selected Grujic v2 consumer?

common_abstraction: Representation sufficiency for a downstream decision/outcome: a coarse producer signature must not identify states with distinct target-critical outcomes.
enabling_assumptions: Only a representation-level implication is tested; no equation-specific Navier-Stokes dynamics are transferred.
The target outcome uses a source-stated structural consequence of the critical profile: one-ball superlevel containment at radius C lambda^(-1/2).
The Lorentz coordinate is compared using the same L^(3/2,infinity) decreasing-rearrangement norm convention.
disanalogies: PNP states are discrete set-system representations; NS states are smooth vector fields in R^3.
PNP downstream outcome concerns closure/reachability; NS downstream outcome concerns geometric concentration morphology.
The hostile NS fields are not suitable weak Navier-Stokes solutions and therefore cannot falsify an equation-specific finite-I implication.
Vorticity direction/log-BMO, far-field control, pre-singularity versus ancient state space, and Type-II behavior are not tested.
predicted_principle: Before seeking an NSE theorem that maps a coarse critical amplitude signature into a geometric-depletion consumer, require a target-morphology coordinate or equation-specific rigidity that separates equal-amplitude states with incompatible core geometry.
cheapest_falsifier: One smooth one-core field and one smooth two-core field with exactly equal L^(3/2,infinity) vorticity magnitude norm but opposite one-center high-threshold containment outcomes.

difference_witness.projection: pi(omega)=|| |omega| ||_{L^(3/2,infinity)} together with smooth/compact/divergence-free class tags
difference_witness.same_projection: exact equality of the Lorentz norm after multiplying each of two disjoint copies by 2^(-2/3)
difference_witness.downstream_outcome: Q_C,lambda(omega)=whether the lambda-superlevel set fits in one ball of radius C lambda^(-1/2)
difference_witness.different_outcome: one-core Q=true; separated two-core Q=false for the same lambda_epsilon and fixed C when epsilon<1
